Brushing time

The time is split into four equal parts: top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left. The car reaches a chequered flag (with a toot and a chime) each time it's time to move on, and the arrow shows where. Children pick a soundtrack (racing, road trip, country or beach van) with the round music buttons on the start screen; tapping one plays a short preview. Children choose their car on the start screen (arrows change the car; the 🎨 button or tapping the car changes its colour). Each finished brush parks that car in the garage, saved on this device only. The screen is kept awake while brushing where the browser allows it.
